defaults.record_note: the recording uses the stream's video bitrate unless one is entered

ts.why: MPEG-TS: 4 header bytes in every 188-byte packet (arithmetic), plus about 64 kbit/s of tables, timing and padding (fitted to ffmpeg's muxer at 3, 6 and 15 Mbit/s)

packet.why: SRT live payload 1316 bytes (7 TS packets); SRT 16, UDP 8, IPv4 20 header bytes (IPv6: 40)

resend.why: SRT resends each lost packet: p / (1 - p) of the data, measured about 5 % above that; bonding adds about 0.9 % of resends for packets that arrive out of order (measured with links of equal delay)

control.why: SRT acknowledgements come back about 24 times a second (about 14 kbit/s) and the sender answers each (about 14 kbit/s up); loss reports grow with loss. With SRTLA every link gets every acknowledgement.

srtla.why: The SRTLA receiver confirms every 10 packets on a link with a 44-byte packet (72 bytes with UDP and IP); a 10-byte keepalive once a second per link, echoed back

mp4.why: An MP4 recording is the audio and video plus about 7 kbit/s of index (measured with ffmpeg at 3, 6 and 15 Mbit/s)
